messages:
customer_eng: FYI - starting ~03:40 UTC we're seeing a spike of 500s for function/tool calls in prod (eu-west-1). Error shows as \"invalid_tool_response: schema validation failed\". Repro steps and logs below.
emma_support: thanks, can you paste the raw request + response you saw? also which model and tool binding?
customer_eng: model=redwood-gpt-ops-prod v2026-02-14, routed to tool 'order_search'. Minimal curl we used:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-gpt-ops-prod\",\"input\":\"find orders for customer 123\",\"tools\":[{\"name\":\"order_search\",\"schema\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"query\"]}}]}'
```
nguyen: logs from gateway:```
[03:41:02] toolcaller: invoke tool=order_search request_id=abc123
[03:41:02] toolcaller: tool_response=200 body=\"[{\n  \"order_id\": \"A-100\",\n  \"total\": 49.99\n}]\"\n
[03:41:02] validator: schema_validation_error expected=object actual=array path=/
[03:41:02] proxy: 500 returning to client request_id=abc123
```
jessica: aha — tool schema expects an object with key `query` in the arguments, but the tool itself returned a top-level array as its result and our validator treats that as an invalid tool payload. Did the model pick the wrong tool or is the tool implementation returning the wrong shape?
alex_p: I inspected recent deploys — the order_search Lambda was updated yesterday to return a raw list for backward compatibility with some internal callers. That breaks the tool schema we ship to external callers.
emma_support: ok immediate mitigation options: 1) patch the validator to accept top-level array for now, 2) rollback order_search to previous behavior, 3) add a compatibility wrapper in the gateway that wraps arrays into {"items": [...] } and update schema. Thoughts?
nguyen: prefer rollback first (fast). I've queued a canary rollback of order_search to v3.4.2 and set the deploy bot to monitor errors.
support_bot: deploy-bot: triggered rollback order_search v3.5.1 -> v3.4.2 in eu-west-1 canary (3% traffic).
customer_eng: during canary we still saw some fails for older requests — maybe some routing landed on instances that had the new code. Repro: sending same curl, sometimes get array, sometimes object.
jessica: that's consistent with a partial deploy. nguyen, can you force a full rollback?
nguyen: doing full rollback now and adding a quick integration test that rejects top-level arrays before promote.
support_bot: deploy-bot: rollback complete. Promoting v3.4.2 to 100% in eu-west-1.
nguyen: post-rollback logs show no more validator errors; clients are green. I also pushed a short-term gateway compatibility patch to coerce array->{"items": [...] } if schema expects object and array is returned, plus an alert if coercion happens. Patch will be removed after customers update.
emma_support: final root cause summary for ticket: order_search service change returned top-level array; Redwood tool schema/validator expects object -> validation failure -> 500 to client. Mitigations taken: full rollback to v3.4.2, temporary gateway coercion + alert, added integration test & deploy guard for tool schema compatibility.
customer_eng: thanks, please add a postmortem in #postmortems and ping legal/partners if any paying customers hit errors. Any follow-ups?
jessica: action items: 1) nguyen to add schema regression test in CI (due EOD), 2) runtime team to add schema compatibility check in canary step (due tomorrow), 3) support to notify impacted customers with timeline (emma_support).
emma_support: will draft customer note and postmortem. marking ticket resolved for now; reopen if we see further errors. :thumbsup:
